modules.module_title: Check the availability of required resources

pcs.pc_description: co-ordinate with the relevant company personnel/ third-party supplier to ensure timely delivery of all the necessary apparatus for the installation of BMS such as Direct Digital Controller (DDC), sensors, actuators, relevant types of cables, Human Machine Interface (HMI) display, computer, server, etc.
check that all the components are delivered as per the order
arrange the necessary tools, equipment, and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for the installation
ensure the availability of trained personnel to assist with the installation process

modules.module_title: Check and test the received resources

pcs.pc_description: examine the BMS apparatus to ensure they are not physically damaged
test the BMS apparatus to ensure the correct functioning
report any issues identified with BMS apparatus promptly to the relevant personnel/ supplier
co-ordinate with the relevant personnel/ supplier to get a timely replacement of damaged/ faulty components
maintain the record of receipt/ replacement and testing of the apparatus

pcs.pc_description: check that all the civil works are completed in the building and necessary approval/ clearance is obtained before starting the installation process
prepare the circuit diagram/ shop drawing/ as-built drawings for the installation of BMS in the building
check that all the outlets related to BMS are accessible and not covered by Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) services
ensure the work area is ready and safe to start the installation of BMS systems
plan the installation process to ensure timely completion as per the client requirements
co-ordinate with the Heating, Ventilation and Air-conditioning (HVAC) installation technician for the installation of HVAC equipment as per the BMS installation plan and client requirements

identify the locations for the installation of various BMS equipment/ devices such as access control, video surveillance, fire alarms, HVAC control, programmable lighting and electric power management as per the BMS installation plan
prepare various equipment for installation as per the manufacturer’s instructions

modules.module_title: Install conduits and carry out wiring

pcs.pc_description: install Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC)/ Galvanised Iron (GI) conduits between the field devices and the control panel as per the plan
carry out wiring to connect all the field devices as per the approved BMS point schedule, wiring schedule and schematic diagrams

modules.module_title: Install the Direct Digital Controller (DDC) with field devices

pcs.pc_description: install the control panel with the required power supply at the selected location as per the approved shop drawings
install and terminate the temperature sensor, humidity sensor, motorized damper actuators for HVAC equipment as per the manufacturer’s instructions
install and terminate the CHW temperature sensor, pressure sensor and flow sensors for CHW pipes as per the manufacturer’s instructions
connect all the field devices as per the approved BMS point schedule, wiring schedule and schematic diagrams
install and connect the field devices such as outside air humidity sensor, water level sensor, staircase pressurisation sensor as per the approved BMS system
install the VFD’s inside AHU control panels and make the required cable connections as per the approved schematic diagrams
install the plumbing system including the water booster pump sets, fire pump sets, water calorifier and pump from the DDC panel, as per the system requirements
carry out terminations at field ends as per the manufacturer’s recommendations
carry out control cabling for DDC control panels through GI conduit or GI trunking above the false ceiling as per approved shop drawings, schematic drawings
label all the control wires with related identifications and connect as per the approved data point schedule

modules.module_title: Install the central peripherals

pcs.pc_description: carry out bus loop wiring from the Central Controller to all the Variable Air Volume (VAVs) and DDC as per the approved schematic drawings
install the pre-assembled peripherals with controllers hubs in the BMS control room
carry out wiring between the central peripherals and the low current systems as per the approved shop drawings
install the central peripherals such as the computer, printer, monitor as per the approved BMS system and shop drawings

modules.module_title: Install the motion sensors

pcs.pc_description: identify the locations for installing motion sensors as per the BMS plan
set up the mounting brackets at the identified locations
install the motion sensors as per the manufacturer’s instructions
connect the motion sensors for BMS digital control

modules.module_title: Install the duct air temperature sensor and duct temperature/ humidity sensor

pcs.pc_description: identify the location of the duct air temperature and duct temperature/ humidity sensor as per the approved shop drawings
drill holes of the recommended diameter using a hole saw cutter and set up the mounting flanges
insert and install the duct air temperature sensor and duct temperature/ humidity sensor on the mounting flanges
ensure the duct temperature/ humidity sensor is mounted on the middle of the duct wall and the sensing element is diagonally bent across the cross-section of the duct
set up the end of the sensing element using the collar provided with the sensor
ensure that the sensing element does not touch the duct wall

modules.module_title: Install the water differential pressure sensor

pcs.pc_description: install the water differential pressure sensor below the pressure measuring points using the GI mounting bracket provided with the sensor
ensure the surface of the installation of the sensor is vibration-free i.e. not on the surface of any equipment with moving parts.
carry out drilling of holes of the recommended diameter at the bottom of the pipes for pressure tapping
use the standard fittings supplied with the sensor to make connections
connect the tapping point to the sensor using the copper capillary tube supplied with the sensor

modules.module_title: Install the air differential pressure sensor

pcs.pc_description: mount the air differential pressure sensor on the duct wall using fasteners supplied with the sensor
install the sensors using GI mounting bracket provided with the sensor
install duct probes in the suction and discharge side of the fans
connect the probes to the pressure sensor using the plastic tubing provided with the sensor

modules.module_title: Install the immersion water temperature sensor

pcs.pc_description: install the thermowell in the chilled water pipeline and temperature sensor inside the thermowell
install the immersion water temperature sensor as per the approved shop drawings and manufacturer’s recommendations.
ensure the stem length is completely immersed in chilled water and the cable entry to the sensor is not from the top of the sensor
apply seal on the socket and sensor threads using Teflon tape

modules.module_title: Install the smoke detectors in AC ducts

pcs.pc_description: drill mounting holes as per the manufacturer’s recommendations for duct housing and to insert air sampling and exhaust tubes
carry out the wiring for detector connection as per the approved shop drawings
install the smoke detector with the base unit inside the smoke chamber using the adopter plates

modules.module_title: Install the butterfly valves

pcs.pc_description: install the butterfly valves in a sandwiched position using appropriate flanges
install actuators after installing and insulating the valves
ensure the valve actuators are not installed upside down
maintain the other actuators in the position recommended by the manufacturer
connect the two-port valves to the piping using threaded fittings or flanges depending upon the pipe diameter

modules.module_title: Carry out pre-commissioning of BMS

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the installation of all BMS components is complete, as per with the approved shop drawings and manufacturer’s recommendations
check that mechanical and electrical installation inspection recommendations are incorporated, ensuring no damage during mechanical completion and pre-commissioning
replace any damaged components as per the SOP
ensure all the relevant systems are pre- commissioned and commissioned as standalone systems
check all peripheral devices are mounted and connected
check all mechanical installations for the correct location and application
check all the cables are connected correctly inside the control panels/ DDC controllers and to the peripheral devices
check the control panel input terminals for interference voltages using an AC range voltmeter
ensure all Fan Coil Unit (FCU) controllers are installed and connected via communication bus
ensure the installation of all the sensors, DP switches, valves is completed both mechanically and electrically
test all control cables point to point using a multimeter

modules.module_title: Carry out commissioning of DDC panels

pcs.pc_description: check the DDC panels have the correct power supply, ensuring personal safety
install the DDC controller software for correct automation of DDC, as per the instructions included with the licensed software
set the controller address, date and time and check for any system alarms
connect the field wiring at DDC controller

modules.module_title: Carry out commissioning of the Fan Coil Unit (FCU)

pcs.pc_description: check for 240Vac at Miniature Circuit Breaker (MCB) or spur socket as applicable
check the status of the LEDs for communications after switching on the power supply module and check for any alarm
check that the network communication link is up between the BMS servers, workstations, DDC Panels, LON to IP converters (LIP) and Building Automation and Control Network (BACnet) controllers
check the values displayed on the graphics screen and confirm that they are linked to the points of concerned plant as per the DDC I/O testing and commissioning check list
test that changes occur in field as per the sequence of operation and the changes are displayed correctly on the graphics screen

modules.module_title: Test the digital and analogue inputs and outputs

pcs.pc_description: check all the Digital Inputs (DI) and Digital Outputs (DO) cables coming from field are volt free
connect each pair of field instrument cable at the appropriate terminals as per the panel wiring termination drawing
shorten and disconnect the wires at the field end and check for appropriate LED status at the DI module
change the Hand-Off-Auto selector switches for all the equipment to auto position
connect all cables of field instruments for analogue inputs/ outputs at the appropriate terminals as per the panel wiring termination drawing
check for availability of 24Vac at each valve motor and field instrument
connect all cables of field instruments for analogue inputs/ outputs at the appropriate terminals as per the panel wiring termination drawing

modules.module_title: Test the communication link, printer and alarms

pcs.pc_description: check that the communication link is up between the servers/ workstations and printers
check the drivers are correctly installed as per the manufacturer’s instructions
test each alarm in the system and validate that the system generates the appropriate alarm message, the message appears at workstations and printers, and any other related actions occur as defined

modules.module_title: Test the third-party system interface connectivity

pcs.pc_description: match the values on the BMS graphics and on the third party system display for different parameters in real time after the third party systems are configured
check and verify the sequence of operations according to the Sequence of Operation Manual after all field cables are verified and checked

modules.module_title: Carry out repair and maintenance of BMS field devices

pcs.pc_description: test the valve actuators, damper actuator, sensors, transducers, high-low limit thermostats, frost thermostats, pressure switches, control valve, relays, emergency stop button and fire/ smoke shut-down, the shut-off operation of spring return actuators and Digital Input and Output (I/O) for the correct functioning
check the field devices for wear and tear or damage
check the BMS is connected with the control system and is online
check repair and maintenance needs of the BMS control system
check the motion sensors are working as expected
clean the valve actuators, damper actuators and sensors
re-calibrate all sensors, transducers, valve start points and actuator travel times as per the requirement
replace the worn out or damaged field devices as per the Standard Operating Procedure
carry out maintenance of the motion sensors or replace them as required
carry out control panel modifications, up- gradation and installations as required

modules.module_title: Carry out repair and maintenance of electrical panels

pcs.pc_description: examine the panel exterior for signs of damage
check the tightness of all the electrical terminations
check the integrity of power cabling insulation
check settings, ratings and operation of protective devices such as overloads, residual current devices, circuit breakers and fuses
check for signs of overheating of components such as contactors, cables, connectors, as well as the internal temperature within the panel
check and re-torque the busbar nuts and bolts
inspect the transformers and power supplies for wear and tear or damage
check the panel is correctly earth-bonded
ensure main door electrical isolator is engaged and operational
ensure ventilation fans and grilles are functional and clean
ensure the isolators, relays, contactors and starters are functioning correctly and free from pitting
ensure the incoming power supply voltages are within the prescribed limits
ensure the cleanliness of panel and components and risk of ingress of dirt or moisture is minimised
ensure status indicators on all panels are functional

modules.module_title: Manage the BMS helpdesk, complaints and requests

pcs.pc_description: manage the BMS help desk, providing a central point for all the BMS-related requests/ complaints
ensure closure of BMS-related requests/ complaints with timely resolution
direct the BMS complaints requiring vendor attention to the concerned vendor promptly
escalate the unresolved complaints to the relevant authority as per the escalation matrix

modules.module_title: Maintain the records

pcs.pc_description: maintain the logs of calls reporting any issues with the BMS
maintain and update documents related to BMS room, device hosting and its maintenance
maintain records and logs regarding the building temperatures, energy consumption, control panel readings, issues encountered and the steps taken to correct the problem, etc.
prepare the daily/ weekly/ monthly Management Information Systems (MIS) report regarding the requests/ complaints received and share with the relevant authority
